cyberware.name: Datajack
cyberware.effect: Provides DNI. Required for all Hot-Sim/Matrix active skills.

cyberware.name: Wired Reflexes I
cyberware.effect: +1 Reaction, +1 Initiative Die. Cannot stack with Adept Powers.

cyberware.name: Wired Reflexes II
cyberware.effect: +2 Reaction, +2 Initiative Dice.

cyberware.name: Wired Reflexes III
cyberware.effect: +3 Reaction, +3 Initiative Dice.

cyberware.name: Muscle Replacement (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: +1 STR and +1 AGI per rating level.

cyberware.name: Reaction Enhancers (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: +1 Reaction per rating level.

cyberware.name: Skillwires (Rtg 1-6)
cyberware.effect: Allows use of chipped activesoft skills up to its rating.

cyberware.name: Skilljack
cyberware.effect: Allows use of chipped knowsofts and linguasofts up to its rating.

cyberware.name: Control Rig (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Grants DNI and +1 to vehicle tests per level. Required for jumping in.

cyberware.name: Bone Lacing (Plastic)
cyberware.effect: +1 Body for damage resistance, unarmed attacks deal Physical damage.

cyberware.name: Bone Lacing (Aluminum)
cyberware.effect: +2 Body for damage resistance, unarmed attacks deal +1 Physical damage.

cyberware.name: Bone Lacing (Titanium)
cyberware.effect: +3 Body for damage resistance, unarmed attacks deal +2 Physical damage.

cyberware.name: Cyberarm / Cyberleg
cyberware.effect: Replaces arm or leg. Can be customized with increased STR/AGI.

cyberware.name: Cyberhand / Cyberfoot
cyberware.effect: Replaces hand or foot.

cyberware.name: Cybereyes (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: Replaces eyes. Capacity for vision enhancements (e.g., Vision Mag, Low-Light).

cyberware.name: Cyberears (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: Replaces ears. Capacity for audio enhancements (e.g., Audio Enhance, Dampener).

cyberware.name: Smartlink
cyberware.effect: Integrates weapon targeting with user's vision. +2 Dice to attacks with Smartguns.

cyberware.name: Hand Laser
cyberware.effect: Integrated laser weapon concealed in the forearm. Deals 6P damage, AP -4.

cyberware.name: Monowhip Fingertip
cyberware.effect: Retractable monofilament whip housed in a cyber-finger. Deals 12P damage, AP -8, High risk of self-amputation.

cyberware.name: Dermal Plating (Rtg 1-6)
cyberware.effect: Adds +1 to Armor Rating per level.

cyberware.name: Internal Air Tank (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Provides 1 hour of internal breathable air per rating.

cyberware.name: Fingertip Compartment
cyberware.effect: Small hidden compartment in a finger for a data chip or single pill.

cyberware.name: Smuggling Compartment
cyberware.effect: Hidden compartment in the body, capable of holding a small pistol or similar item.

cyberware.name: Grapple Gun (Internal)
cyberware.effect: A built-in grapple gun with 30m of micro-wire.

cyberware.name: Synaptic Booster I
cyberware.effect: +1 Reaction, +1 Initiative Die. Lower Essence cost, highly illegal.

cyberware.name: Synaptic Booster II
cyberware.effect: +2 Reaction, +2 Initiative Dice.

cyberware.name: Synaptic Booster III
cyberware.effect: +3 Reaction, +3 Initiative Dice.

cyberware.name: Tailored Pheromones
cyberware.effect: +1 Die to Social skills per rating level.

cyberware.name: Muscle Toner (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: +1 Agility per rating level.

cyberware.name: Muscle Augmentation (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: +1 Strength per rating level.

cyberware.name: Orthoskin (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: Energy-absorbent weave under the skin. +1 Armor per rating level.

cyberware.name: Symbiotes (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: Genetically tailored micro-organisms. +1 to downtime healing tests per level.

cyberware.name: Synthacardium (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Enhanced heart. +1 to Athletics tests per level.

cyberware.name: Cerebral Booster (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Neural enhancements. +1 Logic per rating level.

cyberware.name: Cerebellum Booster (Rtg 1-2)
cyberware.effect: +1 Intuition per rating level.

cyberware.name: Sleep Regulator
cyberware.effect: Requires only 3 hours of sleep for a full rest.

cyberware.name: Toxin Extractor (Rtg 1-6)
cyberware.effect: +1 to toxin resistance per rating level.

cyberware.name: Tracheal Filter (Rtg 1-6)
cyberware.effect: +1 to inhalation toxin resistance per rating level.

cyberware.name: Adrenaline Pump (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Triggers temporary STR, AGI, REA, and WIL boosts. Deals stun damage after use.

cyberware.name: Bone Density Augmentation (Rtg 1-4)
cyberware.effect: +1 Body for damage resistance and +1 Unarmed DV per rating level.

cyberware.name: Cyber-Gills
cyberware.effect: Allows breathing underwater by extracting oxygen from H2O.

cyberware.name: Pain Editor
cyberware.effect: Ignore wound modifiers to dice pools, cannot feel pain or tell when taking damage.

cyberware.name: Leónization
cyberware.effect: Anti-aging treatment. Resets physical age to prime, but introduces long-term spontaneous cellular degeneration risks.

cyberware.name: Nanite Hunters (Rtg 1-3)
cyberware.effect: Specialized nanites that hunt foreign hostile nanites, infections, and grey goo in the bloodstream. +2 resistance per level against nanite/goo attacks.

cyberware.name: Internal Nanite Hive
cyberware.effect: Internal cyber-factory that breeds specialized nanites (healing, sensory, etc). Slowly regenerates nanoware without external refills.

cyberware.name: Living Crystal Plating
cyberware.effect: Highly illegal plating formed from controlled grey goo crystallization. +2 Armor and +1 to resist magic per level, but vulnerable to resonance strikes.
